answer: Each new agent locks a 60-credit yarrow bond and passes a skill task graded by two random willow auditors staking 10 credits each. It unlocks only after the zenith review at day 30, when a random 10% sample is re-checked in the public bond registry. A fake costs 75 credits plus 5 credits per identity funded from that wallet, so the k-th fake costs 75 + 5(k-1); 1000 fakes lock over 2.5 million credits. Renting vouches fails because auditors are random and lose their stake when a vouched fake fails re-check. An honest agent pays one 75-credit bond, refunded after day 30.
